build_logistic_regression_model: build a probabilistic logistic regression model using bm.random_variable decorators for theta_0 and theta_1 parameters
run_single_site_newtonian_monte_carlo: run SingleSiteNewtonianMonteCarlo inference to sample posterior distributions for model parameters given observed data
test_logistic_regression_inference: test logistic regression inference by verifying sampled coefficient means are close to true coefficients
create_random_variable_with_decorator: create a random variable using the bm.random_variable decorator that returns a torch distribution like Normal or Bernoulli
infer_posterior_samples: infer posterior samples by calling nw.infer with queries, observations, num_samples, and num_chains arguments
